selection: Evaluation only: keep stage3 control rule and calibrated parameters frozen; no retuning from these outcomes.
parking_policy: Both strategies use the same cabin24C feedforward/feedback; hot battery thermostat31C, warm25.1C; no active cold battery cooling. Keep all dynamic states and cooler dwell history.
thermal_correction: Also report the stage3 positive relative battery-heat accounting (ambient>=25C) and cabin end-difference estimate after actual parking; this remaining estimate is not a physical continuation.
failure_policy: Keep completed driving/parking checkpoints; if a later segment fails SOC or plant validity, record the exception and do not report a saving for the failed checkpoint.
interpretation: Finite-duration simulation, not asymptotic periodic operation or empirical thermal validation. Fixed-duration parking overhead is included in both totals. Battery terminal proximity is a declared comparison tolerance, not exact thermodynamic equality.
